questions.q: The contents of Social Studies are structured around three broad domains of educational learning. Which domain deals primarily with the acquisition of factual knowledge, reasoning, and conceptualization?
options: The Affective domain
The Cognitive domain
The Psychomotor domain
The Intuitive domain
questions.explain: The **Cognitive domain** involves knowledge, mental skills, comprehension, and the ability to conceptualize facts. It focuses on intellectual development.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: In the context of the Social Studies curriculum, the **Affective domain** focuses extensively on cultivating the learner's:
options: Physical strength, stamina, and motor coordination
Ability to calculate complex mathematical equations
Feelings, emotions, values, and attitudes
Memorization and recall of historical timelines
questions.explain: The **Affective domain** relates to emotional responses. In Social Studies, it is concerned with the development of proper values, empathy, attitudes, and ethical judgments.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: Which of the following activities best represents the **Psychomotor content** of Social Studies education?
options: Explaining the theoretical concept of democratic voting
Participating actively in a practical community environmental sanitation exercise
Believing strongly in the internal importance of civic honesty
Listing the names of all the traditional rulers in a state
questions.explain: The **Psychomotor domain** involves physical action, coordination, and practical application. Participating in a sanitation exercise represents translating civic knowledge into physical action.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: A comprehensive Social Studies syllabus includes facts, concepts, values, and skills that must primarily be relevant to:
options: Only the political leadership of the nation
The historical past without any connection to the modern context
Both the learners and the society in which they live
Only the demands of the international community
questions.explain: Educational content in Social Studies is designed to be highly pragmatic, ensuring it is **directly relevant to the learner's daily experiences** and the developmental needs of the society.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: Which of the following options accurately lists the main components that make up the content of Social Studies?
options: Myths, legends, magical spells, and folktales
Facts, conceptualization, skills, values, and attitudes
Algorithms, chemical formulas, trigonometry, and geometry
Fictional literature, poetry analysis, and literary criticism
questions.explain: According to the syllabus, the meaning of Social Studies content is encapsulated in the teaching of **facts, conceptualization, skills, values, and attitudes**.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: Teaching a student to appreciate and respect the cultural differences among the various ethnic groups in Nigeria falls strictly under which educational domain?
options: Cognitive
Psychomotor
Affective
Analytical
questions.explain: Appreciation, respect, and tolerance are intrinsic emotional responses and belief systems; therefore, they are classified under the **Affective domain**.
